core_rule: Literary devices build layers of meaning. Use metalanguage to name these tools and explain how they shape meaning.

hint_levels.template: What word patterns change text feel?
Devices like filters on photo. Change mood, keep subject.

worked_example.question: Identify sound device in 'The boom of breaking surf' and explain effect.
worked_example.answer: Onomatopoeia ('boom') mimics loud, powerful ocean sound.
worked_example.explanation: Word sounds like noise it describes. Creates immersive experience for reader.

learning_objectives: Identify sound devices like alliteration and onomatopoeia
Explain how imagery creates layers of meaning in First Nations poetry

explanation_sections.heading: What are Literary Devices?
explanation_sections.body: Tools authors use. Go beyond literal meaning. Sound, rhythm, imagery make text more than words. Metalanguage names these tools.

explanation_sections.heading: How to Analyse Layers
explanation_sections.body: 1. Spot device. 2. Name with metalanguage. 3. Connect to theme or mood. Ask: why this sound here? How does image change my view?

explanation_sections.heading: Model Text Example
explanation_sections.body: 'The campfire crackles in cold night.' Onomatopoeia ('crackles') and alliteration ('c' sound) create sharp, crisp atmosphere. Reader feels chill and hears fire.

explanation_sections.heading: Common Pitfall: Device Spotting
explanation_sections.body: Do not just list devices. Explain why they matter. List is shopping receipt. Analysis is food review.

key_vocabulary.definition: Repetition of consonant sounds at start of words.

common_mistakes: Ignoring how imagery links to culture or context.
real_world_connections: Song lyrics use rhythm and rhyme to stay catchy.
Adverts use alliteration to make brands memorable.
First Nations storytelling uses imagery to link people to Country.

additional_worked_examples.question: Analyse imagery in 'The red earth bled under the sun'.
additional_worked_examples.answer: Personification and colour imagery show harshness of land.
